ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( REGEX( LOWER(Email), ".*\\.(games|garden|glass|free|talk)$" ), BEGINS(LOWER(Email), "info@"), BEGINS(LOWER(Email), "contact@"), BEGINS(LOWER(Email), "career@") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This email address is not allowed. Please enter a valid email address with an allowed domain and prefix.
